title: Teams case chat sync
use_case: Post a card to a Teams channel when a case is created, changes status, severity, assignee or title, or gets a comment, with the case's details, key findings, recommended next steps, latest comments and a link to the case. With the library's chat bridge, people in the channel can set the status or comment from Teams.
trigger: Platform Events, source Case, events Create, Update and Comment Added. Leave When does this playbook run? at Always; the playbook's own settings do the scoping. It can also run by hand from a case.
connections: Taegis.MicrosoftTeams 1.2.4, the Microsoft Teams connector Sophos manages, set to a Teams Workflows webhook URL
Taegis.Case 1.0.5, the case connector Sophos manages, to read the case
requires: Microsoft Teams with Workflows, and Sophos Fusion playbooks under Security Operations > Automations. Two-way also needs the chat bridge in this repo and a Teams outgoing webhook.
mdr_note: Sophos MDR doesn't run or watch this playbook, and it doesn't change what Sophos MDR does. With Managed by at any, Sophos MDR cases are posted too, comments included, so check who is in the channel.
rollback: None for posted cards. Turn the playbook off to stop posting.
author: Aaronjacobs000
summary: This playbook posts a card to a Teams channel when a case is created, changes status, severity, assignee or title, or gets a comment. The card carries the case's details, key findings, recommended next steps and latest comments with a link to the case, and goes through the Microsoft Teams connector Sophos manages, set to a Teams Workflows webhook URL. With the library's chat bridge and a Teams outgoing webhook, people in the channel can set the status or comment from Teams.
notes:
Testing: - On 2026-10-21 it passed playbookValidateDSLV2 with no errors or warnings, and a run by hand with a person's comment as its input posted the comment's text. - Live tested on 2026-10-22 on a Sophos Fusion test tenant and Microsoft Teams. A renamed copy ran on case events and posted three cards to a real Teams channel through a Workflows webhook, which accepted each one with HTTP 202: one for a reopened case and two for status changes made through the chat bridge. - The bridge's own [chat-sync] comments also fired the playbook, which skipped them, so nothing looped. - On 2026-11-04 version 1.1.0 passed playbookValidateDSLV2 with no errors or warnings. On the same test tenant it ran on a status change and on a new comment and posted two cards to the Teams channel, which the webhook accepted with HTTP 202. Each card showed case details, key findings, recommendations and the three latest comments, without the bridge's [chat-sync] comments or the comment the card was about. - On 2026-11-04 version 1.1.1 passed playbookValidateDSLV2 with no errors or warnings. On 128 Markdown key findings from two test tenants, ITDR finding cases included, Sophos Fusion's own CEL evaluator rendered key findings and recommendations exactly as the repo's tests do, and no card kept a
, a # heading line or a whole paragraph in bold. - A renamed copy of 1.1.1 on the first test tenant posted a card for a new comment (HTTP 202). Run by hand with a Comment Added event marked internal, in the shape the platform documents (case.delta.comment.isInternal), it posted nothing. Known gaps: - The webhook's 202 doesn't show how Teams draws a card, and the 2026-11-04 cards weren't checked in the channel, including how Teams shows the comment times. - Key findings saved as rich text are left out; every case on the test tenant had Markdown or none. - The test cards left out the Open in Sophos Fusion button. - The Create event is untested, because the Cases API refused to create a test case. - No real internal comment has fired the playbook: the test tenant's API credential can't add one, as only partner users can, so the internal check was tested with a hand-run event.
